summary: Statically-typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JS, enabling scalable development and error prevention for large web applications.
usecases: Add type safety to JavaScript projects to catch errors early during development.
Enable scalable maintenance of large frontend codebases with interfaces, generics, and tooling.
Share type definitions across frontend and backend (Node.js) for consistent API contracts.
ideas: Develop a custom DSL or domain-specific language that compiles to TS for specialized applications.
Build a type-safe configuration layer for microservices that validates env vars and API specs at compile time.
Create an interactive learning platform that teaches JS concepts through live TypeScript compilation and type error visualization.
